vehicles.description: This 2023 Tesla Model 3 Performance combines dual-motor all-wheel drive, rapid acceleration, premium factory Performance equipment, and everyday usability. It is presented in excellent condition with a clean interior and strong, smooth driving performance.
vehicles.overview: Experience Tesla's highest-performance Model 3 with dual-motor all-wheel drive, rapid acceleration, upgraded brakes, factory Performance wheels, and premium technology. This vehicle has been prepared for sale by ProCode Solutions and is available for inspection and a scheduled test drive.
vehicles.restorationSummary: This vehicle carries a salvage title and has been repaired and prepared for sale. Detailed information regarding the prior damage, repairs completed, parts used, and available documentation can be reviewed with ProCode Solutions before purchase.
vehicles.whyWeChose: We selected this Model 3 because the Performance trim combines exceptional acceleration, dual-motor traction, premium factory upgrades, and practical everyday usability. Its equipment and overall presentation make it a strong addition to the ProCode Solutions inventory.
vehicles.technicianNote: The same ProCode Solutions team that works with Tesla electrical, computer, charging, cooling, and module concerns also reviews the vehicles prepared for sale.
vehicles.disclosure: This vehicle is listed with a salvage title. Buyers should review the title history, prior damage, completed repairs, and available supporting documentation before purchase.
